english.title: Knowingly concerned in the fraudulent evasion of income tax by self / another.
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were knowingly concerned in the fraudulent evasion of income tax by

(A)_[yourself]_
(B)_[another person]_

by failing to notify His Majesty's Revenue and Customs that between **(..SPECIFY THE INCOME ACCRUAL PERIOD..)

(C)_[you]_
(D)_[he]_
(E)_[she]_

had derived an income which was liable to taxation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 144 of the Finance Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
was knowingly concerned in the fraudulent evasion of income tax by yourself/ another person
by failing to notify His Majesty's Revenue and Customs that between certain dates
you/he/she had derived an income which was liable to taxation

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the curent legislation, please see section 106A of the Taxes Management Act 1970.
(ii) This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording is now OBSOLETE - Repealed by section 371 of and Schedule 7 to the Taxation (International and Other Provisions) Act 2010.
(iii) Section 10 of the Interpretation Act 1978 states that any reference to the Sovereign reigning at the time of the passing of the Act is to be construed, unless the contrary intention appears, as a reference to the Sovereign for the time being. As such, references to ‘Her Majesty’ and ‘the Queen’ have been replaced in the wording of the offences to state ‘His Majesty’ or ‘the King’, although this may not be the strict wording of the legislation.

other.penalty:

None
